text: Kochi is a heritage city with colonial-era buildings, churches and forts. Fort Kochi is noted for Chinese fishing nets, Jew Town, its synagogue area, Mattancherry Palace and art galleries.
Kochi's listed attractions include Fort Kochi, Chinese fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace, St. Francis Church, Santa Cruz Basilica, Cherai Beach and Bolgatty Island.
Kochi is served by Cochin International Airport (COK) and Ernakulam Junction Railway Station (ERS), according to the Incredible India travel information.
Incredible India identifies October to March as the most pleasant period for exploring Kochi.
The Kochi guide describes traditional Kerala breakfast as part of the local food experience and highlights the city's culinary range. It does not specify prices.
Incredible India describes Kochi as having a water metro system. Check the official operator for current routes and service information.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly when visiting religious sites and rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Munnar is a hill station in Idukki district, between the Anamalai and Cardamom Hills. Its landscape includes tea estates, rolling hills and misty valleys.
The Munnar guide lists Mattupetty, Top Station and Echo Point viewpoints, Eravikulam National Park, Tea Museum and Mattupetty Dam among attractions.

For Anayirankal near Munnar, Incredible India lists Cochin, Coimbatore, Madurai and Thiruvananthapuram airports, plus Aluva Railway Station, as transport links. Confirm the best connection for the specific Munnar stop before booking.
The Munnar guide describes June to September as the heavy-rain monsoon period and December to February as cool, pleasant winter months; choose travel dates with these seasonal conditions in mind.

Kochi Metro Rail Limited describes an integrated network of Metro Rail, Water Metro and feeder services. Its listed metro stations run from Aluva through central Ernakulam to Thrippunithura. Check the operator's current route map, service status and fares before travel.
